text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
All things considered, I'm really looking 
forward to this year's Osaka Hai. Sirius 
Symboli's been on fire lately too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
With Symboli Rudolf gone and that girl 
getting injured, I wondered what would 
happen... but the Senior Year is shaping 
up to be pretty exciting after all!

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, will Sirius Symboli really 
show us what she's made of?

text_block_list.name: URA Official with Black Glasses
text_block_list.text:
I'd be troubled if she didn't do it— and 
if she finds it too harsh, then that's as 
far as she goes.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
(Look at me however you want. Colored 
glasses or not, it don't matter to me—)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'll make them understand soon enough.
